pairs.registryProposal: The golden path excludes vendor function-calling, but a server-side tool vocabulary shared across several transports (here one DIRECTOR_TOOL_DEFS set served to two voice vendors plus a browser relay) still faces tool-schema-design and untrusted-result-handling questions. A short note on whether those techniques apply outside the protocol would stop seats from ruling such pairs inconsistently.
